## Description

Uses Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) or Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) to dynamically adjust bid-ask quotes and order sizes based on inventory holding, order book toxicity, and arrival latency.

## Where it may fit

Fast-moving intraday markets, fragmented crypto exchanges, highly volatile equity options.

## Vehicles

HFT firms, crypto market makers, prop trading desks.

## Required data

Level 2 tick-by-tick order book data, position inventory status, execution queue position estimation.

## Caveats

Off-policy offline RL training requires realistic market impact simulators to prevent dangerous live trading strategies.
